# AIR Office

A free, open-source, local-first desktop app for agentic research and knowledge management, built to strengthen capacity in transformative AI safety and existential risk preparedness.

## About

AIR Office is your personal AI safety lab in an app , bringing grounded knowledge management, guardrails tooling, and shareable AI agent harness automations into a user-friendly workspace that adapts to your workflow. Designed for scientists, engineers, evaluators, policy teams, and independent researchers working on transformative AI and its consequences, it keeps your work private, structured, and consistent across sessions instead of scattering across disconnected tools. Together, these capabilities democratize access while supporting human capacity building and open infrastructure across the AI safety and governance ecosystem.

AIR Office is developed by Gyro Governance Lab as part of its work on AI safety and existential risk preparedness.

Agentic chat and tool use run on the Microsoft Copilot SDK harness, including bring-your-own-key and local model endpoints.

## Theory of Change

Mitigating risks from transformative AI requires rapid, high-rigor research and governance, yet capable tooling remains concentrated inside frontier labs while safety practitioners outside them rely on fragmented, cloud-dependent tools that erode human oversight, lack provenance, and expose sensitive work. AIR Office addresses both bottlenecks by putting free, open-source, local-first desktop infrastructure tailored for AI safety and policy workflows within anyone's reach. By integrating grounded knowledge management, automated auditing tools, and structured memory, the workspace prevents AI-induced epistemic drift while keeping humans in final control. Furthermore, its embedded fellowship program and open market allow practitioners across the field to package their methods into reusable community tools, compounding ecosystem capacity and accelerating high-trust safety interventions that would not occur using general-purpose commercial tools.

## Capabilities & Services

- 🏛️ Integrated AI Safety Fellowship and Crafts. Develop research and workflows into reusable infrastructure and contribute them to the community through our frictionless embedded protocols.

- 🛒 Market. Discover reusable resources (Policy documentation, AI Skills, etc), and add them to your AI chat with one click.

- 🔎 Chat. Edit local files, search the web, and run AI safety diagnostics directly from the chat interface.

- 🖼️ Media. Generate images and capture microphone or camera input when the work needs it.

- 🕹️ Arcade. Release stress and recover from occupational burnout by playing arcade video games.

## Grounded Knowledge Management

Build searchable Knowledge collections from reports, papers, specifications, legislation, and standards, then ask your AI agent for grounded answers and follow up drafts. Rich-text Notes hold literature synthesis, evaluation write-ups, design docs, memos, and chat history, all at direct reach by you and your favorite AI automations.

Seeded reference standards include the EU AI Act , the NIST AI Risk Management Framework , the NIST Generative AI Profile , and the OECD AI Principles . Companion collections for development and evaluation work cover UN SDG goals , OECD-DAC evaluation , and UNDP DPI guidance, with NGO Playbook evidence notes available alongside them. Each collection records its edition and source, and you can add your own research and guidance beside them.

## Specialized AI Actions

Actions are ordered AI workflows you create, adapt, or schedule for review, reporting, preparation, or any multi-step method your practice needs.

AI safety and governance startup kit:

- ✍️ Quality Improvement reviews structure, evidence, alternatives, and uncertainty.

- 🔎 Policy Auditing connects claims to evidence and flags unsupported claims.

- 📋 Policy Reporting prepares attributed reports with recommendations and limitations.

- 🧭 Meta-Evaluation reviews provenance and accountability.

- ✨ Text Sanitization removes AI slop and fixes formatting problems.

Actions are ported from our Chrome Extension AI Inspector .

While humans remain responsible for continuous oversight and final judgement, AIR Office helps your AI be aware of that and leverage its capacity for aligned augmentation.

## Security & Privacy

### Local-First Data Sovereignty

Workspace records stay on your computer. Choose local models for on-machine inference or cloud providers for their models and tools. Hosted providers and enabled connectors receive only what each request needs.

Export conversations and notes when you need portable copies. Connecting a folder authorizes that root, and disconnecting it does not delete its files. In Settings and chat you control which tools run and whether changes ask for approval first. A fuller privacy and data-control summary is in the sovereignty documentation on GitHub .

### Release Audit

AIR Office is open source, and its code can be publicly inspected. Before a release is accepted, we check the shipped software with open-source tools for secrets that should never ship, known problems in third-party libraries, license and dependency policy issues in native code, and risky patterns in our own source and in shipped Lab skills. A review that did not finish does not count as a clean result. To report a security issue, see SECURITY.md .

The release review uses:

- TruffleHog: Identifies leaked secrets and credentials.

- Trivy: Detects vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and software bills of materials.

- Semgrep: Scans source code for security flaws using custom patterns.

- CodeQL: Performs deep semantic analysis on source code.

- SkillSpector: Evaluates shipped Lab skills.

## Alpha Release

0.1.0-AIR_Office_Alpha is the first public desktop build.

These builds are unsigned alpha packages. On macOS you may need to open the app from System Settings → Privacy & Security after the first launch. Features may change, and the software can be unstable.

If you want to report a problem, open an issue . Include the app version, the OS, the model, and the steps to reproduce, and strip API keys and private document content.

Full notes: CHANGELOG.md . Documentation, citation, and contributor materials are on GitHub .
